notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have some thrilling news to share today: Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors is officially partnering with Indie.io!

This is a significant milestone for us, and it will allow us to put even more focus on making Defend Earth the best game it can be. As a small team of five developers, it’s been challenging to juggle all the responsibilities needed to bring our game to a wider audience. That's why we began searching for a publisher, and with Indie.io, we've found a partner that truly sees eye-to-eye with us. They have an impressive history of helping indie games grow, and you can check out their other projects on their Publisher Page.

For those unfamiliar, working with a publisher like Indie.io allows indie devs like us to concentrate on development, while they handle important aspects behind the scenes. From managing store pages to designing marketing campaigns and even showcasing games at digital and live events, publishers provide critical support in areas where indie teams often need assistance.

We’re incredibly excited about this new chapter in our game’s journey and everything that lies ahead.

That’s all for now! Don’t forget to Wishlist the game and join our Discord community for future updates!

Best regards and stay safe,
The Defend Earth Team

notes.title: Update 1.5 | Critical Tasks
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents!

In the last few months, we have been hard at work implementing a crucial new feature for the game the "Critical Tasks", as well as many bug fixes and optimizations. In this blog post, we'll dive deep into the thrilling world of critical tasks, the rewards they offer, and the three different task categories that await you.

[h3]1. Critical Tasks: What's the Deal?[/h3]

After you've successfully terminated a mini boss, you're not just racking up points and achievements. You're also gaining valuable intel about the enemy's movements and plans. This intel is crucial for our fight against the Xenos, and it triggers an immediate critical task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/ff135e184727c8eab415af8a41a1777486544b9a.png[/img]

[h3]2. The Countdown Begins[/h3]

Once the intel is in your hands, you'll be tasked with completing a critical task that takes place at a random location across the map. But there's a catch – you'll need to act fast because each comes with a timer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/b50ec1e829c8d736cf5edea31e93af512eab7ae0.png[/img]

[h3]3. The Rewards Await
[/h3]
The completion of these critical tasks is not in vain. Upon successful execution, you'll be generously rewarded with a crate and bonus effects that can turn the tide of battle in your favor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/ea82a38347b21dab4e42656037fb94b20048b345.png[/img]

Let's take a closer look at the three different task categories and the bonuses they offer:

[b]Extraction:[/b]

Task: Your mission here is to retrieve valuable gear, extract vital supplies, or obtain alien technology that could give us an edge in this war.

Bonus Effect: On successful completion, you'll receive a magnetic effect that allows you to collect all nearby items at once. Talk about efficient looting!

[b]Raid:[/b]

Task: Raid missions involve eliminating alien parasites or destroying their jammer and rifts. These objectives are essential to weaken the Xenos' foothold on Earth.

Bonus Effect: Completing a raid task leads to the satisfying outcome of wiping out all minion enemies in your vicinity. The perfect way to clear the battlefield!

[b]Salvage:[/b]

Task: Salvage missions require you to hold your position until evacuation is secured, intel is protected, or survivors are rescued from the clutches of the Xenos.

Bonus Effect: Successfully holding your ground grants you a temporary buff that increases your XP and Aether gain. The longer you endure, the more you'll reap!

[h3]4. Choose Your Path, Agent[/h3]

Now that you're armed with this valuable information, it's time to prepare for your next encounter with the Xenos. Be ready to adapt to any of these critical tasks as they can arise at any moment. The fate of Earth depends on your courage and quick thinking.

In Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors, the fight never ends, but with critical tasks, you have the chance to gain the upper hand and emerge victorious. So gear up, Agents, and prepare for the unexpected. Earth is counting on you!

Thanks for your continuous feedback and support up until now. You have all played a significant role in helping us improve the game and make it truly unique.

Have fun and best regards, 

Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors Team

--------------------------

notes.title: Update 1.4 | Vitality Augmentations
notes.content:
Greetings agents,

we have a new update for you! As always, we appreciate your feedback and support as we work diligently to improve your experience.

[h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3]

We've introduced Augmentations for the Vitality module: Protection and Tenacity. 

[b]Protection[/b]

Generates a shield equal to 25% of the maximum health which regenerates after taking no damage for 10 seconds.

[b]Tenacity[/b]

After taking a fatal hit, the agent is invulnerable for 5 seconds. Tenacity has a cooldown of 5 minutes.


[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]

Since the release of Area 51 and Vol'nar, we've made a series of important modifications. Notably, in regards to some aspects, like values for Vol'nar and projectile size of certain other enemies have been adjusted. We have also revised the damage metrics from final bosses for a better game balance.

Moreover, we have made some subtle changes to the user interface and color coordination, ensuring that your gameplay is as user-friendly as ever.
[h3]
[b]Bugfixes[/b][/h3]

As always we've been hard at work on squashing bugs. Issues related to the range value for specific elements have been resolved. Achievements for certain augmentations are now functioning as they should, and a glitch that was preventing the unlocking of new locations after progression has been corrected.

Also, we have fixed a number of localization typos and inconsistencies.

These updates mark our commitment to continuously refine and improve your experience. As always, thank you for your feedback, and we encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts and suggestions on our forums and Discord.

Stay tuned for more updates. Happy hunting!

Defend Earth Team!

notes.title: Update 1.3 | Area 51 is here!
notes.content:
Hello Agents,

We've picked up strange anomalies around Area 51 in Nevada. The anomalies are unlike anything we've seen before, and they're causing some serious problems. The power grid in the area has been knocked out, and there have been reports of Xeno sightings. We need you to get to Area 51 and find out what's going on.

 

[h3]New Level: Area 51[/h3]

We've created a new level set at Area 51, a top-secret military base that is rumored to be home to alien technology. This level is full of challenges, including new enemy types, environmental hazards, and a boss fight against the powerful Vol'nar.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/0f57c15e57e751a53f2b1fe6b5120ac09a5047a7.png[/img]

[h3]New Enemy Type: Void Hunter[/h3]

Void Hunters are Vol'nar's elite units. They are heavily armored and wield powerful energy weapons. 

Void Hunters are a serious threat to any player who encounters them. Their laser attack is powerful and can deal a lot of damage, especially if you're caught in the blast radius. 

 

[h3]New Boss Enemy: Vol'nar[/h3]

Vol'nar is the final boss enemy of the new level "Area 51". She is a massive creature with powerful ranged abilities.

Vol'nar's normal attack is to shoot projectiles at your from a distance. These projectiles are fast and can deal a lot of damage, so it's important to stay out of their way. Her special attack is to fire a laser at your from a distance. This laser is powerful and can deal a lot of damage, especially if you're caught in the blast radius. After a delay, the laser rotates towards the you.

Vol'nar is a challenging boss, but she can be defeated with careful planning and execution. Her projectiles are easy to dodge if you're paying attention, and her laser attack can be avoided by staying behind cover or timing your movement correctly.

 

We're confident that you have the skills and determination to complete this mission. Good luck, Agents!


[b]Alongside this update, we’ve also launched a 50% sale in order to enable more players to join us in defeating Vol’nar and defending Area 51. This is a limited-time offer for two weeks, so don’t miss out!
[/b]
 

Sincerely,
The Team

The Augmentations are:

[b]Jolt [/b]will stun enemies temporarily, giving you a strategic advantage by immobilizing them and creating openings for follow-up attacks. 

We are excited to see what builds you will come up with with these new augmentations.

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
Hello, Agents!

In this week's update, we're excited to introduce four new Augmentations for the Laser Orb weapon and the Reload module.

[b]Laser Orb weapon[/b]
We're introducing two powerful weapon augmentations: Star and Pulsar. The Star augmentation grants you multiple lasers that orbit around the player, damaging everything they touch. On the other hand, the Pulsar augmentation combines all laser beams into one powerful beam that deals significant damage to everything in front of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/d5fa9a726c7b8a23457b6cdc93cafc687363c41a.png[/img] [i]Star augmentation[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/d2821f67959f2020e1da19deb1d681e41c612b6e.png[/img] [i]Pulsar augmentation[/i]

The second big addition is the Reload module augmentations. 

[b]Reload module[/b]
The Discharge augmentation reduces the weapon cooldown by 25% for 5 seconds every 30 seconds.
The Adrenaline augmentation decreases the weapon cooldown by 25% when your health is below 25%.

To complement these augmentations, we've added 2 new achievements for you to unlock!

Furthermore, we've made several quality-of-life improvements, including enhancements to the UI and UX of the assignment list in the Research Facility. These changes should make it easier to read and navigate through the list.

As always, keep up the great work, Agents!

Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors - Team

notes.title: Update 1.0 | Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

Today's update is a huge milestone for us, as after 6 months of development, we feel finally ready to leave Early Access. First of all, we want to thank all our early supporters who provided us with valuable feedback. Without their constant feedback, this would not have been possible.

On an additional note, we want to point out that leaving Early Access does not mean we will halt development. Instead, we are committed to a tight update schedule, releasing updates on a weekly or biweekly basis, with the frequency depending on the complexity of the content.

Prior to this update, we've implemented 10 agents, 3 main and 3 urgency levels, 10 weapons, 15 modules, 4 augmentations, 10 enemies, and 3 bosses. Additionally, we've added the Research Facility, which enables you to unlock all the additional content by completing various assignments.

But now, let's talk about the update that follows with this release. For the past couple of weeks, we've focused immensely on providing additional content for the early-mid game. This includes 8 new augmentations, which are the biggest addition in this update.

We've also built a new level in which you can complete various urgency missions in a desert environment. Your research team has discovered Xenos intrusions in various deserts around the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/1e5e7c6322b85c9b61065c7c3119a67bd749b526.png[/img]

So that's it for this week's update, and once again, we cannot thank our supporters enough, as you've made this transition possible.

At the bottom of this post, you'll find a list with all the changes included in this update. So there is nothing else left to say except: Be careful out there, Agents! You'll hear from us next week when we release our next update.


Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors - Team

notes.title: Update 0.7.1
notes.content:
Hello Agents! We are thrilled to announce this week's update, featuring a range of new and exciting features that will enhance your gameplay experience.


[h3]New Agent: Maze[/h3]
Maze is the latest addition to the team of agents, and he brings with him a unique set of skills and abilities that make him a valuable asset in the fight against the Xenos. With his specialized training in the use of the Ion Barrier, he has proven to be an exceptional agent, able to protect even the most vulnerable targets with ease.

This skill raises the base drop chance of health packs, making it easier for you to keep their agents alive and in the fight

Players will now have an additional opportunity to improve their draft strategy by enabling a chance for an extra draft option. This will give players more flexibility and increase the potential for strong build.

Reduces the movement speed of enemies, making it easier for players to evade.

Gives the chance to instantly eliminate small enemies on the first attack.

Enables to revive at 50% health once.

[b]Redraft[/b]
This new feature allows you to reroll your gear draft options once, giving you a second chance to choose the equipment that best suits your playstyle and strategy.

notes.title: Update 0.6.4 | Facility "Atlantis"
notes.content:
Welcome to our latest update for DEFCON: Xenos! We've been working hard to bring you new content, rebalanced gameplay, and bug fixes. Here's a rundown of what's new:

[h1]New Content[/h1]

[h3]Facility “Atlantis”[/h3]
We're proud to announce the addition of our newest level, Facility Atlantis! This Research Lab is hidden in the midst of the Atlantic, and we can't wait for you to explore it. With new challenges and threats to overcome, Facility Atlantis is sure to keep you on your toes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/8fc98f31adb2797bd0aebc1aaa752bef7271350b.png[/img]

[h3]The Slinger[/h3]
We're excited to introduce our newest enemy, the Slinger! With their advanced long-range capabilities, they can shoot at you even if you're behind cover, providing a completely new kind of challenge. You'll have to be quick on your feet and strategic in your approach if you want to overcome this formidable foe. Take on the challenge and see if you have what it takes to outsmart the Slinger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/cade35ad440737ccd9885788094572e63d6fa387.png[/img]

[h3]Urgency Missions[/h3]
We have added "urgency missions" which become available once you have completed the Paris mission. Urgency missions are issued on a semi-random basis, meaning that they are only available for a limited time and will be replaced if you choose not to play them. Urgency missions are very different from regular ones. There are 4 different types of Urgency missions and they are played on a variety of new maps. With this update, we have added two of those maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/1c8988209635eda109d0fdb48f17dc5d13c491c6.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Changes & Bugfixes[/h1]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
We've heard your feedback and made some adjustments to make the game more enjoyable. We reduced the difficulty of early waves in Paris, as well as the HP of Rhino enemies. We also rebalanced the final boss Demolitionist in Berlin.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
We fixed a bug where some Rhino bosses had the wrong dash size value, and adjusted the experience value for certain mini bosses. Enemies should no longer spawn within your field of vision.

We hope you enjoy these updates and as always, happy hunting!

notes.title: Update 0.6.1 | Research Facility
notes.content:
Welcome Agents!

We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest update that brings new and exciting features to the game. We have been working tirelessly to bring you a better gaming experience, and we believe this update will not disappoint.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Research Facility[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/71f1324dfe043465c2a868149a7bfb4bc546febf.png[/img]

The Research Facility is the most significant feature we've implemented in this update. You can now get assignments in order to unlock new Weapons, Modules, and powerful Augmentations. The Research Facility provides a new way to play the game, allowing you to explore and experiment with different weapons and modules, and unlock new possibilities.

[h2]Augmentations[/h2]

[h3]Razorblade Torque[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/85e5fc90d5a7c4c7a040d136c9552781234797d0.gif[/img]

The Razorblade is a highly advanced weapon that is equipped with two unique augmentations. The first augmentation, the Razorblade Torque, is designed to increase the velocity of the weapon's blades. By doing so, this augmentation allows the Razorblade to cut through alien hordes with incredible ease, making it a highly effective weapon for defending against extraterrestrial threats.

[h3]Razorblade Globe[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/5a96d7f818bce09eb6c9d7bdf25f38dd14186ea3.gif[/img]

The second augmentation, the Razorblade Globe, is equally impressive. This augmentation is specifically designed to increase the size of the blades on the Razorblade. By doing so, the blades become almost impossible to miss, making the weapon highly accurate and deadly in combat situations. 

[h3]Gatling Gun "Rapidfire" & "Impact"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/cd29c2c5e3227dbd7993ef71f2fa310f2d82cfac.gif[/img]

During boss fights, having the right augmentations for your weapons can make all the difference. The "Rapidfire" and "Impact" augmentations for the Gatling Gun are two such examples. While the Gatling Gun is already a formidable weapon, the "Rapidfire" augmentation takes it to a whole new level by allowing it to fire continuously without a cooldown period. This means that you can unleash an unrelenting barrage of bullets on your target, dealing massive damage in a short amount of time. On the other hand, the "Impact" augmentation adds splash damage to the Gatling Gun's shots, making it even more effective against groups of enemies or larger targets. With these two augmentations equipped, you'll be well-prepared for any boss fight that comes your way.

[h2]New Agent Neo, the Artillery[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/7e103a14a4458ee70e2f787d726da7801d56f0fb.png[/img]

We are thrilled to introduce our newest agent, Neo, the Artillery. With his powerful Missile Rain, he can take down hordes of aliens with ease. We are excited to see how you will use him in your runs.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]

We have added 25 new achievements to the game, giving players even more goals to strive for.

[h1]Balancing and Improvements[/h1]
We have also made many changes to balancing, ensuring that the game is fair and challenging. The improvements we've made will make the game more enjoyable, and you'll appreciate the quality-of-life improvements that will make playing the game easier and more seamless.


We are excited about this update and can't wait for you to experience it yourself. We value your feedback, and we are committed to providing you with a better gaming experience. We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed creating it.

Thank you for your support and stay tuned for more information on the upcoming update which will include new content for the game. 

DEFCON: Xenos Team

notes.title: Update 0.5.4 | New Agent!
notes.content:
Greetings Agents!

We are thrilled to announce the arrival of a new agent to the game - Vulcan. Vulcan brings with him an arsenal of advanced technologies and an unwavering determination to protect humanity from the Xenos threat.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/9a51a843af062772bdd76689393ea87aa7bc9f4f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337127/a9aadd994ca03b89bc76633910e87d36fd6991f9.png[/img]

Step into your new HQ, Commander, with its new 3D background, the first of many visual improvements we are making to elevate your overall gaming experience.


That will be all for this week. Stay tuned for next week to find out about some big changes coming up. 


And now, get ready to take on the Xenos threat with Vulcan by your side!

DEFCON: Xenos Team out!

notes.title: Price drop for DEFCON: Xenos - now only 2.99$!
notes.content:
Greetings Operators!

We are thrilled to announce that due to the overwhelmingly positive reception of our game, we have decided to make it more accessible to all of you by reducing the price from 4.99$ to 2.99$. This is a big step for us as we want to gather as much feedback as possible to continue improving the game and building on existing features.

We understand that some of you might be wondering why we're making this change now. The reason is simple, we want to make sure that as many people as possible have the chance to experience our game and give us their valuable feedback. With a lower price point, we hope to reach a wider audience and gather even more insight on how to make DEFCON: Xenos the best it can be.

We would also like to take a moment to express our deep gratitude to all of our early supporters and buyers. Without you, we would not have been able to make the game what it is today. We truly appreciate your contributions and we are honored to have you as part of our community. Thank you for believing in us and for helping us make DEFCON: Xenos a success.

Please note that this price reduction is not a permanent change, and we will be re-evaluating the price once we've added more content to the game. We want to make sure that we are offering the best possible value to our players.

We can't wait for you to dive deeper into the world of DEFCON: Xenos and we hope that you'll enjoy the game as much as we do. We are extremely grateful for your support and feedback, and we'll continue working hard to make DEFCON: Xenos the best it can be.

Thank you for your continued support,

The DEFCON: Xenos team
